components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled action. Panda green, white label.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #1B7F64; color: #fff; height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #176b54; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1B7F64; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The alternate action. System fill, no tint.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #E5E5EA; color: #000; height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #D1D1D6; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1B7F64; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Grouped Cell
components.description: One row in an inset group. The whole row is the control.
components.html: 认识大熊猫科普
components.css: .ds-group { background: #fff; border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; } .ds-cell { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 16px; text-decoration: none; color: #000; } .ds-cell-name { display: block; font-size: 17px; line-height: 26px; } .ds-cell-detail { display: block; margin-top: 2px; font-size: 13px; line-height: 18px; color: #636366; } .ds-chevron { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-right: 1.6px solid #636366; border-top: 1.6px solid #636366; transform: rotate(45deg); } .ds-cell:hover { background: #D1D1D6; } .ds-cell:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1B7F64; outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: The 找熊猫 search. Filled, 10px corners, no stroke.
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; background: #fff; border-radius: 10px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; } .ds-search input { flex: 1; border: none; background: transparent; font-size: 17px; outline: none; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: #636366; } .ds-search-icon { width: 14px; height: 14px; border: 1.6px solid #636366; border-radius: 50%; position: relative; } .ds-search:focus-within { outline: 2px solid #1B7F64; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Plate
components.description: A published photograph, edge to edge, captioned underneath.
components.css: .ds-plate { margin: 0; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; color: #000; } .ds-plate-photo { aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; background: #E5E5EA; } .ds-plate figcaption { padding: 8px 16px 0; font-size: 13px; line-height: 18px; color: #636366; }

narrative.northStar: A photograph on the system shelf.
narrative.overview: 吱熊猫 is a phone atlas of named giant pandas. The shelf is the iOS 26 interface a fan already knows: a large title, a system back chevron, a Liquid Glass tab bar, and inset grouped lists. The thing on the shelf is a photograph of one animal. Green is the tint on the selected tab, a link, and the filled button. The website keeps its olive paper. The app does not.
keyCharacteristics: Tab roots use a 34px large title that collapses into the bar on iOS.
Lists that navigate are inset groups with a 10px radius.
Body is 17px, with line height opened for Chinese.
One tint, the panda green. Photographs carry the rest of the color.
Dark mode is true black grouped background and elevated #1C1C1E groups.

rules.name: The Tint Rule
rules.body: Green marks what a fan can do: the selected tab, a link, the one filled button, a correct quiz pick. It does not fill a card or sit above a title.

rules.name: The Shelf Rule
rules.body: Page ground is the system grouped background. Do not bring the website's olive paper onto a screen.

rules.name: The System Style Rule
rules.body: Pick an iOS text style. Do not invent a size between them.

rules.name: The Plate Rule
rules.body: The first figure on a panda or a 科普 article is one published photograph. The caption sits under the picture. Text is not placed on the picture.

rules.name: The System Material Rule
rules.body: Blur and glass belong to the tab bar and the navigation bar, drawn by the system. A card does not get its own glass.

dos: Do use a published photograph of the panda the sentence is about.
Do keep draft 科普 out of the public catalog.
Do use the system back button and the system tab bar.
donts: Don't put a kicker above the title.
Don't put an icon in a tinted square.
Don't paint a card, a progress track, or a hero with the green tint.
Don't hand-roll a glass panel. The system bar is the only glass.
Don't bring the website's olive ground or custom back button onto the app.
